scope: Reusable blank rank templates and interchangeable suitcase emblem

samples.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this approved New mastery badge into a REUSABLE BLANK TEMPLATE. Preserve the supplied image's exact composition, canvas proportions, placement, transparent margins, silhouette, outline widths, colors, soft illustrated shading, flower ornaments, decorative rim, folded banner and any rank-specific sprout/laurel/crown/wings. Do not redesign or reposition anything.
Make ONLY these three content removals:
1. Remove the large WK lettering from inside the creamy circular badge face. Leave a clean, continuous creamy face matching the existing local gradient. Keep the little decorative flower above the old letters when present, because it belongs to the badge background.
2. Remove the picture/landscape symbol from the FRONT of the lower curved ribbon, filling its former area seamlessly with the banner's existing color and shading.
3. Remove the L1 lettering from that ribbon. Leave that whole banner front blank, still visibly curved with its original folds and shading.
The final template contains NO WK, suitcase, picture, pencil or level lettering. Keep the original badge illustration and decorative ornaments completely unchanged. These blank areas are for interchangeable UI overlays later.
Genuine transparent background with alpha, preserve all opaque pale/cream subject details, no checkerboard or painted backdrop. Keep the complete silhouette and SAME spatial layout as the supplied image. One badge only.
